assumption: Build29683 four-profile captures bound native fault ordering and low-byte conversion; not all NT kernels.
basis: native-v1/v2 before-after PE/source/NTDLL identities and finite cases
stress-test: 2240 fault rows plus APC and i64 boundary waits per retained revision
falsification-probe: replay bound captures; run exact producers on another kernel

assumption: All guest waits use private object-table references and scheduler parking; no host wait handle is opened for a guest request.
stress-test: last handle close, duplicate, abandoned owner and cancelled waiting thread
falsification-probe: host wait FFI reachable from guest adapter, or leaked retained ObjId

assumption: Existing kernel continuation can use CallSite + Flow::Block with a status-to-Flow::Resume wrapper instead of applying HLE callee cleanup.
basis: dispatch::complete already pins/unpins waits and Flow::Resume restores explicit registers; services.rs currently rejects Block.
dependent-result: native blocked return and APC lifetime
stress-test: all guest ABIs, WoW sp+4 resume, native x64 RCX restoration, APC same-height frontier, cancellation and abandoned context
falsification-probe: PC/SP differ from immediate NT return, native frame pruned during APC, or duplicate cleanup

assumption: Absolute native deadlines must preserve their clock domain rather than silently become infinite or lose clock adjustments.
basis: primary NtWaitForSingleObject signed100ns contract and native v2 huge/past/future cases
dependent-result: new private deadline representation and polling
stress-test: NULL,0,+1,-1,i64MIN/i64MAX, forward/backward realtime movement and signal/APC priority
falsification-probe: finite future loses deadline, overflow, or native pending wait resolves before target after backwards clock adjustment

assumption: Full BOOL truth was initially considered for Win32 WaitForSingleObjectEx but is contradicted by all four native revision2 runs.
basis: win32-apc alertable00000100 rows are false,00000101 true
dependent-result: narrow measured adapter correction; no global c.bool change
stress-test: all seven alert values and both signaled states
falsification-probe: independent Win32 producer yields full nonzero normalization

assumption: The documented Kernel32 provider always exports QueryUnbiasedInterruptTimePrecise on this supported host.
basis: Microsoft realtimeapiset requirements table names Kernel32; native v4 returned no export in all four profiles.
stress-test: v5 compares both borrowed providers on all four profiles and binds six module files before and after.
falsification-probe: Kernel32 export missing with KernelBase export present.

assumption: Verified source hashes alone ensure Cargo rebuilt a different worktree when a target directory is reused.
basis: macOS epoch3 reused the corrected tests-only baseline binary in0.28s despite different worktree contents.
stress-test: Fresh isolated target directory and exact15-test selection, then full suite and archive member identity.
falsification-probe: Old nine-test binary or stale package path in artifact metadata.

assumption: Changing CARGO_TARGET_DIR also updates the retained C++ helper archive selection.
basis: The first native consumer script still hard-coded target-io-completion-owned while Cargo selected target-wait-owned.
stress-test: Separately named helper binds the actual carrier path, byte length and SHA256 before and after all five linked consumers.
falsification-probe: A C++ link uses the parent archive or before/after digests differ.

assumption: Prepending the new native export leaves pre-existing synthetic NTDLL ordinals and trap RVAs unchanged.
basis: The PE builder assigns ordinals and slots by table iteration order; the epoch3 ordinal regression compiles and fails.
dependent-result: Compatibility with pre-existing ordinal imports and trap locations
stress-test: Construct old/new actual PE images for all three guest ABIs, comparing every old ordinal/symbol RVA and appending exactly one new export.
falsification-probe: An old symbol moves or the new wait is not the final entry.
